lead: The gut's favourite amino acid. L-glutamine is the primary fuel for the cells lining your gut — 3.15 g per scoop to support intestinal integrity, a healthy gut barrier and recovery after training. Unflavoured, mixes into anything.
note: 30 servings · 3.46 oz (98 g) · ships in 1–2 days

science.title: Why your gut loves glutamine
science.text: L-glutamine is the most abundant amino acid in your body — and the preferred fuel for the fast-renewing cells that line your intestines. That makes it central to maintaining a healthy gut barrier ('intestinal integrity'). Under stress, illness or hard training your body can burn through its glutamine, so topping it up supports gut health, immunity and recovery.

format.title: One amino, mixes into anything
format.text: No flavour, no fillers but a touch of anti-caking — just pure L-glutamine that dissolves into water, juice or a smoothie without changing the taste.

absorb.title: Feed the gut barrier

points.title: Intestinal integrity

points.title: Recovery & immunity
points.text: A key amino for the immune system and muscle recovery, especially when training depletes your stores.

ingredients.title: One pure amino acid

facts.side_text: 3.15 g of free-form L-glutamine per scoop, with only a touch of silicon dioxide to keep it free-flowing — no flavours or fillers. Made in the USA — 98 g, 30 servings.
facts.warning: If you are pregnant or nursing, under 18, have kidney or liver issues, or take medication, consult a physician before use.

steps.title: One scoop, stir in
steps.text: Mix 1 scoop (3.3 g) into 6–8 oz of water or juice and stir until dissolved.

steps.title: On an empty stomach
steps.text: For gut support, take it on an empty stomach — first thing in the morning or between meals.

steps.title: Or after training
steps.text: For recovery, have it after a workout to help replenish what hard training depletes.
